title: Police real-time operations center
summary: As of November 20, 2024, the department is waiting for Washington to release money for a real-time operation center grant. The chief said the department asked the Congressional Delegation after the fire to fund the center.

timeline.text: A Council committee voted 7-1 to advance safeguards on automated license plate reader technology and deferred action on a facial recognition bill.

source.quote: Maui County Council members voted 7-1 in committee Thursday to put safeguards on how local law enforcement uses automated license plate reader technology, but they deferred action on a second bill addressing facial recognition technology that is not yet deployed by the Maui Police Department.

timeline.text: The chief said the department is waiting for Washington to release money for a real-time operation center grant.
The chief said the department asked the Congressional Delegation after the fire to fund a real-time operation center.
